name: Becoming Mira – Avatar
description: Mira Vale met een gezicht (Anam) en de ElevenLabs-agent, met de Webfuse-tools om op becomingmira.com te kijken en te navigeren.

tools.name: wizard_get_state
tools.description: Read the current screen of a data-agent-* instrumented form: which step is shown, its selectable options, its input fields, any alternative actions, which navigation controls are available, any error message, and a `prompt` telling you what to do next. Call this first and after anything unexpected.

tools.name: wizard_select_option
tools.description: Choose one of the options on the current screen by its `value` from wizard_get_state. By default it also presses Next afterwards so one call completes one question; pass advance:false to select without advancing (useful when the user is still deciding). Returns the resulting state.

advance.description: Press Next after selecting. Default true.

tools.name: wizard_fill_fields
tools.description: Fill one or more input fields on the current screen. Pass an object keyed by the `field` names from wizard_get_state, e.g. {"postal-code":"9722 GP","house-number":"10"}. Handles text inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios. Does NOT submit — follow up with wizard_navigate. Returns the resulting state.

fields.description: Map of data-agent-field key to the value to enter. Use true/false for checkboxes.

tools.name: wizard_navigate
tools.description: Press one of the form's navigation controls: next, back, submit or restart. Check wizard_get_state's `nav` to see which are available on this screen. Waits for the form to settle and returns the resulting state.

tools.name: wizard_action
tools.description: Invoke a secondary action offered by the current screen — for example skipping an optional step or retrying after a failure. Use the `value` from the `actions` list in wizard_get_state. Returns the resulting state.

env.description: Zelfde waarde als AVATAR_WEBFUSE_KEY in Vercel
